description: A change the user made in the account section of Settings (7.7): any of the provider, the API key, the model, the thinking effort and the cache lifetime. `llm` saves it on the server and announces llm.changed. Only the fields that changed are present; an empty `key` removes the stored key. `jevKey` is the account's Jev key, kept beside the provider's key and independent of the provider; an empty `jevKey` removes it. The key is marked secret (7.2), so the bus keeps it out of the trace.
